# ODS-maintained Source 4.3.43 candidate

This ODS-maintained candidate records the release-contract and metadata fix at
functional checkpoint `728c9a6e34341a4fa727c726acbbcdecef1fc8c3`. It is not
upstream or supported-release promotion, physical Mac qualification,
owner-account acceptance, provider authorization or an installed-release claim.

## Scope and version boundary

The checker classifies the fifteen exact, independently hash-bound historical
ODS qualification documents as evidence before its ordinary authored-pin scan.
Missing or changed known evidence is refused; unknown names and ordinary
authored pins remain scanned. The frozen LIVE-AUDIT 4.0/4.1 authority checks
are unchanged. Its two Gmail configure expectations now match the existing
optional bounded `newer_than` window templates; configure behavior is unchanged.

The release manifest now lists the already implemented Gmail and Calendar
metadata-count tools, added at functional commit
`cc49a94b991b99e254e0b5555e6b21740a62dc09`. The Source plugin implementations
and their declared tool surface were already present. This fixes release
metadata drift without adding tools, arguments, provider access or authority.

A different exact Source ref requires a strictly newer ordinary update version,
so this candidate advances 4.3.42 to 4.3.43. Current migration/archive contracts
are qualified for exactly 4.3.43; wrong prior and unknown next targets remain
refused. Prior compatibility rows and qualification records remain immutable.
The OpenClaw runtime, dependencies, image references/digests, signing and trust
policy, provider permissions and implementation behavior are unchanged.

## Scoped functional evidence

At checkpoint 728c, the focused checker/configure controls passed six cases,
including tampered and missing known history, an unknown same-prefix file,
an ordinary authored pin, optional/no-window query rendering and invalid bounds.
The real full checker passed once in an isolated full-repository-scope copy.
That copy added exactly four legitimate immutable private Git blobs and
rendered only the two audit-link labels whose presence the unchanged generator
depends on. Those private files and derived labels are not in the public
Source payload or its bundle. Earlier public-export and private-scope failures
remain recorded; this result does not relabel the incomplete public export.

This new record is separately frozen and hash-bound by the checker before
classification. It does not contain its own digest or its final bundle identity.
Final candidate tree, two independent synthetic-root bundle builds, pins,
migration/identity/custody controls and remaining qualification are recorded in
the ODS provenance outside this Source tree after those checks complete.

## Remaining qualification

Packaging and local component checks do not establish ordinary installed
Windows/WSL adoption, real provider or owner-account flows, or physical Darwin
installation/update. No private source history, release signature or upstream
approval is claimed. Historical 4.3.42 clients and receipts remain exact readable
identities; a new candidate must not rewrite them.
